imagePrompts.prompt: A classroom corner decorated as a 'Global Hub'. There is a globe on a table, toy airplanes hanging from the ceiling, and pictures of diverse people holding hands around the world. Children are exploring the items.
Children interacting with modes of connection. One child holds a toy phone pretending to call. Another pushes a toy ship on a blue mat (sea). A map of the world is in the background.
A role-play scene of 'Travel and Trade'. Children carrying small suitcases or bags. They are handing paper money to a 'trader' sitting at a table with goods. It shows connecting with others.
Community circle. Children holding pictures of an airplane, a ship, and a bus. They are miming the actions (flying arms, steering wheel). Discussing how we travel far away.
Children grouping toy vehicles on the floor. They put planes in one hoop (Air), boats in another (Sea), and cars in a third (Road). They count the vehicles in each group.
A classroom market scene representing international trade. A child 'trader' displays shoes and bags. A 'traveler' arrives with a suitcase to buy items. Interactive play.
Language Experience Approach. Teacher writing a story on a chart about 'Buying and Selling'. Children are watching. Beside them, two children role-play trading goods with play money.
A child holding a book, showing the back cover to the class. Another child points to the front cover. The teacher nods. They are identifying parts of a book.
Interactive reading. Teacher reads a sentence from a Big Book. Children repeat it (echo-reading). They point to illustrations of airplanes and ships in the book.
Children arranging letter cards on a table to spell simple words like 'BUS' or 'VAN'. They blend the sounds. One child is writing the word in an exercise book.
Children drawing a picture of a means of transport (e.g. a trotro or bicycle). They label it with initial letters. They share their drawings with friends.
A child speaking to the class, holding a toy plane. They are forming a sentence like 'I travel to Dubai'. The teacher writes the sentence on a strip of paper.
A buying and selling role-play. A child counts paper money to pay for a toy car. The 'seller' hands over the car. They use polite words and simple sentences.
